title: Shell Yeah! on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Welcome to "Shell Yeah!" – a timeless coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Grayton Beach
description_expanded: Welcome to "Shell Yeah!" – a timeless coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Grayton Beach's historic village center. This exquisite three-bedroom vacation home comfortably accommodates up to seven fortunate guests, offering an unforgettable seaside escape. The residence boasts a raised wraparound veranda, providing a stunning 180-degree panorama of the glistening Gulf and the rolling sugar-white dunes of the renowned Grayton Beach State Park . This west-facing haven is the perfect spot to savor your favorite tropical drinks and snacks while witnessing breathtaking sunsets year-round. Step inside the open and spacious living, dining, and kitchen area, thoughtfully designed to maximize those heavenly views. Walls of sliding glass doors lead to the veranda, where you can soak in the sensational scenery. The living area exudes nautical charm, featuring a light-colored couch, plush blue Vintage Modern accent chairs, and a washed denim-style rug centered around a cocktail table. These inviting furnishings face a flat slate stone mantle adorned with stained glass lanterns and a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV for entertainment. A rustic dining table with six natural hardwood cottage-style chairs sits nearby, perfect for enjoying meals while gazing at the spectacular sunsets. For more intimate dining, four round cushioned stools are available at the ash-streaked granite entertainment bar. The state-of-the-art kitchen is a culinary delight, complete with white custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and brushed stainless steel appliances to inspire family feasts. The primary bedroom is a serene retreat, featuring a king-size bed framed by milk chocolate coastal-style furnishings. Two windows invite natural light, while a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV ensures evening relaxation. The private ensuite bath is a luxurious escape, with a white cabinet housing dual vanity sinks, smooth pebble stone flooring, and a walk-in shower adorned with glittering mosaic tile. A guest bedroom, bathed in natural light, offers dove-gray coastal furnishings and a queen-size bed facing a wall-mounted flatscreen TV. This room shares a hall bath with a charming bunk room, which includes both a full and twin bed. Beyond the beauty of the beach, " Shell Yeah " is perfectly situated near the heart of Grayton Beach's vibrant village. The iconic Red Bar is just steps away, serving delicious food, craft cocktails, wine, and beer, along with nightly live music. The unique Zoo Gallery , located across the street, showcases a vibrant collection of decorative art, jewelry, and whimsical coastal furnishings crafted by talented artists nationwide. Tribe Kelley Surf Post , right next door, offers chic coastal fashion and handpicked shore-inspired accessories. A short stroll takes you to Destin's famed AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar , which has a Grayton Beach location just a minute away by car, serving up fresh Gulf-caught seafood and hosting lively bands that play late into the night. This prime location also provides easy access to other coastal gems, including the charming villages of Seaside and Santa Rosa Beach, where you'll find more dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Outdoor amphitheater concerts, festivals, and specialty shops await your exploration. "Shell Yeah" invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of Grayton Beach and create memories that will last a lifetime. Enjoy! First Floor: Covered Parking. Second Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Bedroom with Queen Bed, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry
